_note: 批次B1 · v2(已采纳 4 视角对抗验证 41 条/21必改)。三个成体系硬伤已修:①**美国车险不赔车内私人物品**——车损走 comprehensive,背包/笔记本走 renter's/homeowner's 的 off-premises 条款(另计免赔额),v1 把这段推理建在不存在的前提上,学员照念会以为东西没人赔而放弃索赔;②**三条报案渠道必须分清**——911 只用于正在发生/刚发生且嫌疑人可能在附近;已结束、无嫌疑人的车内失窃走非紧急线 1-877-ASK-LAPD 或 CORS 网上报案,警察多半不到现场;③**DR number 与 incident number 不是一回事**——电话当场给的是 incident number,保险要的 DR number 要等报告入档后下发,网上报案先拿临时受理号。安全行为链重排:先离开孤立位置→报警→等待期间才取证问监控;不徒手碰玻璃(留给警察/玻璃店);嫌疑人在场时绝不走出掩体(v1 让学员到店门口挥手是错的)。补入整批最大缺口:背包里有家门钥匙+行驶证(印着家庭住址),洛杉矶砸车后接着入室盗窃是已知链条,当天必须换锁。术语:侧窗砸碎是 replacement 不是 repair;加州**没有**法定零免赔玻璃险,侧窗更换 200-450 美元常低于 500 美元免赔额、通常不值得走车险。

emergency-call._line: 本场景定位 911:正在发生或刚发生且嫌疑人可能在附近。已结束的案子走 car-breakin 的非紧急线。

entry.en: I'm at Third and Vermont in Los Angeles.
entry.zh: 我在洛杉矶第三街和佛蒙特街路口。

entry.en: Someone is breaking into a car.

intermediate.en: I need the police — it just happened and the guy may still be around.
intermediate.zh: 我需要警察——刚刚发生的，那个人可能还在附近。

intermediate.en: I'm in the parking lot at Third and Vermont in Los Angeles.
intermediate.zh: 我在洛杉矶第三街和佛蒙特街的停车场。

intermediate.en: My callback number is 213-555-0142.
Someone smashed my car window and took my backpack.
intermediate.zh: 有人砸了我的车窗，拿走了我的背包。

intermediate.en: No one is hurt.
intermediate.zh: 没有人受伤。

intermediate.en: I saw someone running toward Vermont about two minutes ago.
intermediate.zh: 大概两分钟前我看到有人朝佛蒙特街跑了。

intermediate.en: He was wearing a red jacket and carrying a dark backpack.
intermediate.zh: 他穿着红色夹克，背着一个深色背包。

intermediate.en: I've moved inside the store — I'm not going back out there.
intermediate.zh: 我已经进到店里了——我不会再出去。

intermediate.en: I'll stay here until an officer arrives.
intermediate.zh: 我会待在这儿，直到警察来。

advanced.en: I need the police right now — someone is breaking into a car in this parking lot.
advanced.zh: 我现在就需要警察——有人正在这个停车场撬车。

advanced.en: I'm at the supermarket on Third and Vermont in Los Angeles — the lot on the side of the building.
advanced.zh: 我在洛杉矶第三街和佛蒙特街的超市——楼侧面的停车场。

advanced.en: My callback number is 213-555-0142.
He's still there, next to a silver sedan a few rows in.
advanced.zh: 他还在，就在里面几排的一辆银色轿车旁边。

advanced.en: I'm inside the store — I haven't gone out there.
advanced.zh: 我在店里——我没有出去。

advanced.en: He's wearing a black hoodie — maybe thirty years old.
advanced.zh: 他穿着黑色连帽衫——大概三十岁。

advanced.en: I can't tell if he has a weapon, and I'm not going any closer.
advanced.zh: 我看不出他有没有武器，我也不会再靠近。

advanced.en: There's a white van backed in next to him with someone sitting inside.
advanced.zh: 他旁边倒着停了一辆白色厢型车，里面还坐着人。

advanced.en: He's walking out toward Vermont now, on foot.
advanced.zh: 他现在正步行朝佛蒙特街方向走。

advanced.en: Yes, I can stay on the line until the officers get here.
advanced.zh: 可以，我会一直不挂，直到警察到。

advanced.en: I'm staying inside by the front counter — I'm in a blue jacket, and they can come find me.
advanced.zh: 我就待在店里前台旁边——我穿蓝色外套，他们可以进来找我。

car-breakin._line: 本场景定位已结束的砸车失窃:非紧急线/网上报案,以及后续换锁与换玻璃。

meta.title: 车被砸·车内失窃
meta.subtitle: Car break-in
meta.description: 洛杉矶最高频的一种案子：回到车前发现车窗被砸、包被拿走。安全撤离、报案、当天换锁、叫上门换玻璃。
learn: 先离开孤立位置再报警，玻璃留给警察别徒手清
无嫌疑人的车内失窃通常网上或电话报案，警察多半不到现场
问报案编号给保险（网上报案先拿临时号）
包里有钥匙和行驶证＝对方拿到住址，当天换锁
叫上门换玻璃（replacement），问清含不含吸玻璃碴

entry.en: I need to call the police.

beginner.en: I've already called the police — they're on the way.
beginner.zh: 我已经报警了——他们在路上了。
有人砸碎了我副驾驶那侧的车窗。

beginner.en: My backpack was on the seat, and now it's gone.
beginner.zh: 我的背包本来在座位上，现在不见了。

beginner.en: I parked here last night, and I just came back this morning.
beginner.zh: 我昨晚停在这儿，今天早上才回来。

beginner.en: There's glass everywhere — I haven't touched anything.
beginner.zh: 到处都是玻璃——我什么都没碰。

beginner.en: I'm taking photos of everything, and I'll leave the glass for the police.
beginner.zh: 我把一切都拍下来，玻璃留给警察处理。

beginner.en: Excuse me, do you know if this lot has security cameras?
beginner.zh: 打扰一下，你知道这个停车场有监控吗？

beginner.en: I'll wait by the store entrance until they get here.
beginner.zh: 我在店门口等着，直到他们来。

intermediate.en: Hi, is this the right number for a non-emergency report?
intermediate.zh: 你好，非紧急报案是打这个号码吗？

intermediate.en: Someone broke into my car — it happened overnight.
intermediate.zh: 有人撬了我的车——是夜里发生的。

intermediate.en: They smashed my window and took my backpack.
intermediate.zh: 他们砸了我的车窗，拿走了我的背包。

intermediate.en: It's at a public parking lot at Third and Main, in Los Angeles.
intermediate.zh: 在洛杉矶第三街和主街的一个公共停车场。

intermediate.en: No one was hurt, and I didn't see who did it.
intermediate.zh: 没有人受伤，我也没看到是谁干的。

intermediate.en: Can I file this online, or does an officer need to come out?
intermediate.zh: 这个能网上报案吗，还是需要警察出警？

intermediate.en: There was a laptop in that backpack, and I have the serial number written down.
intermediate.zh: 那个背包里有台笔记本电脑，序列号我记下来了。

intermediate.en: If I file it online, how long before I get the report number for my insurance?
intermediate.zh: 如果我网上报案，多久能拿到给保险用的报案编号？

intermediate.en: My house keys and my registration were in that bag — I'm changing the locks today.
intermediate.zh: 我的家门钥匙和行驶证都在那个包里——我今天就去换锁。

advanced.en: Hi, my car window was smashed last night — do you do mobile window replacement?
advanced.zh: 你好，我的车窗昨晚被砸了——你们上门换玻璃吗？

advanced.en: It's the front passenger window on a 2019 Honda CR-V.
advanced.zh: 是一辆 2019 款本田 CR-V 的前排副驾驶车窗。

advanced.en: It's drivable, but I've only taped plastic over the window — there's still glass down in the door and all over the seats.
advanced.zh: 车还能开，但我只用塑料布把窗口封上了——门里和座椅上到处都是玻璃碴。

advanced.en: Does the price include vacuuming the glass out?
advanced.zh: 报价包含把玻璃碴吸干净吗？

advanced.en: Can you also check the door lock and the window regulator while you're there?
advanced.zh: 你们来的时候能顺便检查一下门锁和升降器吗？

advanced.en: I think I have glass coverage — do I need to open a claim first, or can you bill my insurance directly?
advanced.zh: 我应该有玻璃险——我需要先开理赔吗，还是你们能直接跟我的保险结算？

advanced.en: If I pay out of pocket instead, what's the total with tax?
advanced.zh: 如果我自己付，含税总共多少钱？

advanced.en: How soon could you get someone out to me?
advanced.zh: 最快什么时候能派人过来？

advanced.en: Do I need to be there the whole time, or just long enough to hand over the keys?
advanced.zh: 我需要全程在场吗，还是把钥匙交给你们就行？

advanced.en: Is there a warranty on the glass and the installation?
advanced.zh: 玻璃和安装有保修吗？

advanced.en: Great — let's book it for tomorrow morning.
advanced.zh: 好的——就约明天上午吧。

insurance-claim._line: 本场景定位车被砸/失窃后的车险理赔;车内私人物品明确路由到 renter's/homeowner's。

meta.title: 保险理赔
meta.subtitle: Filing an insurance claim
meta.description: 车被砸、东西被偷之后打给保险公司：报案拿 claim 号、问免赔额值不值得报、约定损、选修理厂。
learn: 报案说清时间地点与损失
车损走 comprehensive，**车内私人物品走 renter's / homeowner's 保单**
免赔额常高于换一块侧窗的钱，未必值得报
定损单与修理厂报价对不上怎么周旋、租车怎么算

entry.en: I want to report a claim.

beginner.en: Hi, I'd like to file a claim on my auto policy.
beginner.zh: 你好，我想用我的车险报一个理赔。

beginner.en: My policy number is on my card — let me read it to you.
beginner.zh: 保单号在我的卡上——我念给你听。

beginner.en: Someone smashed my car window and took my backpack.
beginner.zh: 有人砸了我的车窗，拿走了我的背包。

beginner.en: It happened overnight in a parking lot.
beginner.zh: 是夜里在一个停车场发生的。

beginner.en: I already filed a police report.
I filed it online, so right now I only have the temporary number.
beginner.zh: 我是网上报的案，所以现在只有临时受理号。

beginner.en: I also took photos of the damage.

intermediate.en: Hi, I'm calling to follow up on a claim I filed yesterday.
intermediate.zh: 你好，我想跟进一下我昨天报的理赔。

intermediate.en: The claim number is 0-4-8-2-6-1-9-3-3-7.
Is the window covered under comprehensive?
intermediate.zh: 车窗走综合险能赔吗？

intermediate.en: What's my deductible on this one?
intermediate.zh: 这一项我的免赔额是多少？

intermediate.en: The repair quote is under my deductible — should I just drop the claim?
intermediate.zh: 修车报价比我的免赔额还低——我是不是干脆撤掉这个理赔？

intermediate.en: The backpack and laptop were inside — I think that's my renter's policy, not this one, right?
intermediate.zh: 背包和笔记本电脑在车里——那部分应该走我的租房保险，不是这份，对吗？

intermediate.en: When will the adjuster contact me?
intermediate.zh: 定损员什么时候联系我？

intermediate.en: Can I use my own repair shop, or does it have to be one of yours?
intermediate.zh: 我能用自己找的修理厂吗，还是必须用你们指定的？

intermediate.en: Could you email me a summary of everything we just went over?
intermediate.zh: 能把我们刚才谈的内容整理成邮件发我吗？

advanced.en: Hi, I'd like to go over the estimate the adjuster sent me.
advanced.zh: 你好，我想跟你核对一下定损员发给我的估价单。

advanced.en: The shop quoted me four hundred more than what's on your estimate.
advanced.zh: 修理厂给我的报价比你们的估价单高出四百美元。

advanced.en: They said they found damage to the window regulator that wasn't on your estimate, so they're writing a supplement.
advanced.zh: 他们说发现升降器也坏了，你们的估价单上没有，所以要补一份追加单。

advanced.en: Could you have the adjuster call the shop directly to work that out?
advanced.zh: 能让定损员直接跟修理厂沟通解决吗？

advanced.en: The shop says it'll be in for two days — do I have rental reimbursement on this policy?
advanced.zh: 修理厂说要修两天——我这份保单有租车补偿吗？

advanced.en: What's the daily limit, and how many days does it cover?
advanced.zh: 每天的限额是多少？总共能覆盖几天？

advanced.en: I'm putting the stolen laptop through my renter's policy, so let's keep this claim to the vehicle damage.
advanced.zh: 被偷的笔记本我走租房保险，所以这个理赔就只算车辆损失吧。

advanced.en: Is a comprehensive theft claim treated as not-at-fault in California?
advanced.zh: 在加州，综合险的失窃理赔算作无责吗？

advanced.en: If I close this out with no payment, does it still show up on my claims history?
advanced.zh: 如果这个理赔零赔付结案，还会留在我的理赔记录里吗？

advanced.en: Please put a note on the file that I'd like a phone call when there's a decision, not just an email.
advanced.zh: 请在档案里备注一下：有结果时我希望接到电话，而不只是邮件。

advanced.en: And then follow up with the same thing in writing, so I have a record.
advanced.zh: 然后再把同样的内容用书面发我一份，我好留个记录。
